items.title: No study combines the costs and attendance of group care
items.whyItMatters: The board's question is cost per additional attender, which no retrieved record answers.
items.opportunity: Combine local attendance and cost data in one analysis.

items.title: Women choose group care, so users differ from non-users
items.whyItMatters: Comparing users would overstate the effect.
items.opportunity: Compare hubs offering group care with other hubs, before and after.

items.title: Interpreter and childcare costs vary widely
items.whyItMatters: They drive the cost difference (claim c2).
items.opportunity: Cost them from invoices and vary them in sensitivity analyses.

items.title: Groups with the lowest attendance
items.whyItMatters: Young women and women new to the country attend least.
items.opportunity: Report attendance and cost-effectiveness for these groups.

errorsFound: The first scan reply assigned a certainty to leads recalled after a failed search; it was dropped.
reevaluation: An economic evaluation comparing hubs before and after remains the right design, with uptake and equity handled explicitly.
summary: Four gaps; the missing combined evidence and self-selection are high severity.
